scenarios.title: Clerk auth, tenant isolation and project scoping
scenarios.description: Multi-tenant boundary verification: users from Tenant A cannot observe or query Tenant B resources.

scenarios.title: 4-document concurrent upload and revision persistence
scenarios.description: Ingest Contract, BoQ, Schedule, Technical Spec under pinned revision IDs with strict format enforcement.

scenarios.title: Health 6-dimension vector, honest nulls and Coherence Score
scenarios.description: Assess evidence coverage for 6 dimensions; unmeasured dimensions remain null/UNKNOWN; calculate 0-100 score only with valid coverage.

scenarios.title: Source evidence deep links and WBS linkage
scenarios.description: Trace each finding and alert to verified source revision, span/row/activity, and link to WBS node when applicable.

scenarios.title: Granular HITL ledger and atomic candidate settlement
scenarios.description: Item-by-item human review preserves immutable candidate; final acceptance is a separate atomic human act.

scenarios.title: P0c What Changed and P0d Current State temporal parity
scenarios.description: Compare Revision A vs Revision B without hallucinating deltas; Health updates only on reliable events.

scenarios.title: One approved WBS, Budget, Schedule and interdocument coherence
scenarios.description: WBS approved baseline references Budget and Schedule; detect cross-doc discrepancies; NOT_ASSESSED on non-comparable values.

scenarios.title: Session persistence, relogin, cross-tenant denial and runtime SHAs
scenarios.description: Ensure state, scores, decisions survive logout/relogin; verify runtime deployment SHAs.
